visual.detail: Manager must inspect all views for placement, proportions, missing/extra parts and visible intersections
visual.observation: A square tile with an engraved sunburst on its face and two raised tongues at one pair of corners. Front: the two tongues rise from the tile and lean, and the rest of the face is flat -- the sunburst is engraved into it rather than raised. Top: the two tongues sit at adjacent corners, on the diagonal away from the star. Iso: the tongues are attached at their feet with no undercut, the sunburst rays are cut in, and the tile floor is flat where a piece stands. Nothing floats, no extra tongue, no visible intersection.
